items.name: config-biome-base
items.title: Biome Config Base
items.description: Shared Biome formatter + linter foundation: double quotes, trailing commas, 2-space/lf, recommended lint preset, organize-imports assist. Every other Biome fragment/preset builds on this.

items.name: config-biome-solid
items.title: Biome Config Solid
items.description: Solid.js domain rules (reactivity, destructured props, component detection) layered on top of config-biome-base.

items.name: config-biome-tailwind
items.title: Biome Config Tailwind
items.description: Tailwind v4 CSS parsing/formatting/linting layered on top of config-biome-base.

items.name: config-biome-app
items.title: Biome Config App
items.description: Ignore rules specific to deployed applications (e.g. Cloudflare Workers' .wrangler dev cache), layered on top of config-biome-base.

items.name: config-biome-lib
items.title: Biome Config Library
items.description: Stricter rules for published packages/libraries (e.g. no console statements shipped to consumers), layered on top of config-biome-base.

items.name: config-biome-preset-solid-tailwind-app
items.title: Biome Preset: Solid + Tailwind App
items.description: Root biome.jsonc for a Solid.js application styled with Tailwind (e.g. a TanStack Start app deployed to Cloudflare Workers).

items.name: config-biome-preset-solid-tailwind-lib
items.title: Biome Preset: Solid + Tailwind Library
items.description: Root biome.jsonc for a Solid.js component/config library styled with Tailwind (e.g. ts-kit itself).

items.name: config-biome-preset-tailwind-lib
items.title: Biome Preset: Tailwind Library
items.description: Root biome.jsonc for a library that ships Tailwind CSS but has no Solid.js runtime (e.g. client-styleguides).

items.name: config-biome-preset-solid-lib
items.title: Biome Preset: Solid Library
items.description: Root biome.jsonc for a Solid.js component library with no Tailwind CSS (e.g. strapi-blocks-solid-renderer).

items.name: config-biome-preset-lib
items.title: Biome Preset: Plain Library
items.description: Root biome.jsonc for a plain TypeScript/Node library published for other packages to import — no Solid.js, no Tailwind CSS.

items.name: config-biome-preset-base
items.title: Biome Preset: Base Only
items.description: Root biome.jsonc with no app/lib shape assumptions — for internal CLI tools/scripts that are neither a deployed app nor a published library (e.g. gcemail), so config-biome-lib's published-package rules (like restricting console usage) don't misfire on a tool whose whole job is console output.

items.name: config-eslint-tanstack
items.title: ESLint Config TanStack
items.description: Residual ESLint layer for TanStack-specific rules Biome cannot express. Pair with a config-biome-* preset, which owns formatting and general-purpose/Solid linting.

items.name: config-eslint-valibot
items.title: ESLint Config Valibot
items.description: Residual ESLint layer for the @ospm/eslint-plugin-valibot rules Biome cannot express. Pair with a config-biome-* preset, which owns formatting and general-purpose linting.
